task.title: Does the passage contain the key information?
task.description: Compare a retrieved passage with reference passages and say whether it contains the key information.

questions.text: Does this passage contain the **key information** from the reference?
What specific information is missing? Write a short sentence.

instructions.summary: Check whether a retrieved passage includes the **key information** of the reference passages.
instructions.background: The reference passages contain the correct answer to the question.

criteria.label: Yes
criteria.text: The passage states or clearly implies the key facts needed to answer the question.

criteria.label: No
criteria.text: The passage misses the key facts, even if it is about the right topic.

steps: Read the question and the reference information.
Choose Yes or No; if No, describe what is missing.
notes: Focus on the facts needed to answer the question.
instructions.tip: A passage about the right topic can still miss the specific detail asked for.

planner_notes: Records with more than three reference passages are filtered out to keep rows small; there is no existing label for this task.
